name: Ouyang Yu
source:
A reserved pianist who longs to play on her own terms.
With excellent grades and a privileged background, Ouyang Yu seems to have everything. She rarely explains herself or seeks out company; at the piano, her feelings become easier to hear.

When the music she loves meets the weight of other people's expectations, whose melody will she choose? Get closer and hear the wishes she has never spoken aloud.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/846660/Cicadas/]Steam[/url]]
